description: Permanently delete a custom source tag and all its pattern assignments; retain source records. Read the source-tag listing tool first and supply the tag's current revision in the expected-revision input. Built-in source categories cannot be deleted. Obtain explicit user confirmation identifying the tag and its assignments before calling. MCP executes immediately after authorization; Athena AI chat presents an approval card. If the tag changed, read again and obtain approval for a fresh deletion. Never retry a declined proposal unless the user requests it. A false analytics-refresh result means the tag was deleted but filtered analytics may still be cached.

expected_revision.description: Revision returned by the source-tag listing tool for this tag.

tag_id.description: Custom source tag ID returned by the source-tag listing tool.

name: delete_source_tag
